basic_details.job_title: ESIC Gurugram Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 39 Specialist, Senior Resident and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: ESIC Model Hospital Gurugram, Haryana, of the Employees' State Insurance Corporation has called eligible candidates to a walk-in interview on 13 November 2026, from 09:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The venue is the Chambers of Medical Superintendent, 2nd Floor, ESIC Model Hospital, Sector 9A, Gurugram, Haryana - 122001. The interview under Advertisement No. 05/2026 is for 13 Full-Time Contractual Specialist posts at a consolidated Rs. 1,48,263/- per month and 26 Senior Resident posts in Level-11 with Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- plus other allowances as per 7th CPC.

The discipline-specific eligibility of each post is in Annexure-E of the official notification.

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format, Annexure-F, in capital letters. Applications in any other format and incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.
Prepare a separate application for each post, along with the requisite fee.
Report at the venue on 13 November 2026 between 09:00 AM and 10:30 AM.
Submit the application form, with the demand draft where the fee applies, at the Document Verification cum walk-in-interview.

Before the interview, candidates may also send a copy of the completely filled Annexure F, with relevant and supporting documents and their contact number, to [email protected] till 13 November 2026. Annexure-F asks for details including the speciality and post applied for, NMC registration number, category, demand draft details, educational qualifications with number of attempts, and work experience. It also asks about any Senior Resident service in Central Govt. or State Govt., any NOC from the present employer, and any dismissal or punishment. Its declaration covers Indian citizenship and the accuracy of the statements made.
important_instructions: The Competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies without any prior notice at the time of interview, and to fill up all posts or not to fill up any post without assigning any reasons. The Competent Authority also reserves the right to alter the date or venue, or cancel the interview, without assigning any reasons. If a suitable reserved category candidate is not available, the seats may be filled up for less than 45 days by an available candidate of any category. Selected or applied candidates will have no claim or right for regularization of the service or preference for regular appointment in the ESIC hospitals. The engagement may be terminated or discontinued by either side giving 01 (one) month prior notice without assigning any reason. If a regular candidate is appointed or joins, the appointment shall be terminated as per the condition of the contract. A selected candidate has to enter into an agreement with the Medical Superintendent on Non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/-, at the candidate's own cost. The original contract stays with the hospital and a copy with the candidate. A selected candidate has to furnish a Security Deposit in favor of "ESIC Fund Account No. 2", payable at State Bank of India, Gurugram. The amount is not specified in the notice. No TA / DA will be admissible either for the walk-in interview or for joining the post. Hostel accommodation, quarters and uniform will not be provided, and private practice will not be allowed. Wrong declarations, false information or any other action contrary to law shall lead to cancellation of the candidature at any stage, in addition to suitable legal action. Candidates shall be governed by the relevant rules and regulations adopted by the ESI corporation, and other terms and conditions will apply as issued by the competent authority from time to time. For queries, contact the office of the Medical Superintendent, ESIC Model Hospital, Sector-9A, Gurugram, Haryana, at landline no. 0124-2252001 between 10:00 AM to 04:00 PM from Monday to Friday and from 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturday. Queries may also be emailed to [email protected] with a contact number till 13 November 2026. The fax number on the application form is 0124-2255133.

content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format, Annexure-F, in capital letters. Applications in any other format and incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Prepare a separate application for each post, along with the requisite fee. Report at the venue on 13 November 2026 between 09:00 AM and 10:30 AM. Submit the application form, with the demand draft where the fee applies, at the Document Verification cum walk-in-interview. Before the interview, candidates may also send a copy of the completely filled Annexure F, with relevant and supporting documents and their contact number, to [email protected] till 13 November 2026. content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring all original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies of the following: Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.) Address Proof (Ration Card, Passport, Driving License, Aadhar Card etc.) Age Proof (Matriculation/10th Certificate or Birth Certificate) Registration Certificate with Medical Council of India or State medical Council Internship Completion Certificate and attempt certificate Educational Qualification certificates (10th/12th/MBBS/MD/MS/DNB) Experience certificate and No Objection Certificate (if applicable) Reservation category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PWD/EWS/Ex-servicemen) in the format prescribed by Govt. of India Two recent Passport-size Photographs Duly filled Bio data form as per Annexure-F, with a recent passport size duly attested colour photograph affixed OBC: The OBC Certificate as given at Annexure-A, along with the Self Declaration at Annexure-B to be given at a later stage. Without them, the benefit of reservation or age relaxation will not be given. OBC reckoning date: The closing date for receipt of application is treated as the date of reckoning for OBC status and for assuming that the candidate does not fall in the creamy layer. The certificate must be issued on or before that closing date. EWS: The EWS Certificate given at Annexure-C. Ex-servicemen: The form of undertaking given at Annexure-D. It records that the candidate is not eligible for a vacancy reserved for ex-servicemen if the candidate has earlier secured civil employment by availing that reservation concession. Validity: Reserved category candidates must hold certificates valid for the current year in the prescribed format of Govt. of India, and the latest certificate in the case of OBC candidates. Government Service: A candidate working in the Government Service should submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Document Verification cum Walk-in-interview at the venue. A candidate has no right to be interviewed merely by submitting an application, unless the candidate reports at the venue on the scheduled date and time. Candidates who do not produce all the relevant documents at the time of interview will not have their candidature considered for the post. The decision of the selection board will be final on all aspects of selection, and no further correspondence will be entertained. Joining or appointment of a selected candidate is subject to medical fitness and detailed scrutiny of the eligibility conditions and documents. If required, details of unfilled vacancies after the interview will be notified on the website, and a Rolled Over walk-in interview will be held on the date decided by the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the ESIC Gurugram walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 13 November 2026, from 09:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The venue is the Chambers of Medical Superintendent, 2nd Floor, ESIC Model Hospital, Sector 9A, Gurugram, Haryana - 122001.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in this ESIC Gurugram recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 39 vacancies: 13 for Full-Time Contractual Specialist and 26 for Senior Residents (03 Years). The Competent Authority reserves the right to change the number of vacancies at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for these ESIC Gurugram posts?
faq.answer: Both posts need a PG Degree or PG Diploma in the concerned specialty, and the Specialist post also needs 03 years' experience after the PG Degree or 05 years after the PG Diploma. If post graduate doctors are not available for Senior Residents, an MBBS doctor with the printed experience may be considered for 01 Yr.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ESIC Gurugram walk-in?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 69 years for Full-Time Contractual Specialist and 45 years for Senior Residents, as on the date of interview. Relaxation is as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ESIC Gurugram Specialist and Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: A Full-Time Contractual Specialist gets a consolidated Rs. 1,48,263/- per month. A Senior Resident gets initial pay in Level-11 with Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- plus other allowances as per 7th CPC, less the deduction printed for candidates without a PG Degree.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: For Senior Residents, other allowances as per 7th CPC are paid on top of the Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/-. For Full-Time Contractual Specialists, the notice gives a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,48,263/- per month and names no separate allowance.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates bring to the ESIC Gurugram walk-in?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring all original certificates, one set of self-attested photocopies, two recent passport-size photographs and the filled Annexure-F. Identity, address and age proof, medical registration, educational, internship and applicable experience, NOC and category certificates are included.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected at ESIC Gurugram?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Document Verification cum Walk-in-interview, and the decision of the selection board is final. Joining is subject to medical fitness and detailed scrutiny of the eligibility conditions and documents.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate apply for both posts?
faq.answer: The notice says that an application should be submitted for each post separately along with the requisite fee.

faq.question: Q10. Are these ESIC Gurugram posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, the posts are contractual, with a tenure of 03 years and annual evaluation. Selected or applied candidates have no claim or right for regularization of the service or preference for regular appointment in the ESIC hospitals.
